categories.name: Flaunch Ecosystem
categories.content: Flaunch Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via flaunch.gg.

categories.name: Bridged WBNB
categories.content: Bridged WBNB refers to Wrapped BNB that has been transferred from its native blockchain to a different blockchain through "bridging".

categories.name: aarna Vault Tokens
categories.content: aarna Vault Tokens are vault-specific ERC-20 tokens representing shares in aarnâ's tokenized vaults. Users deposit stablecoins like USDC/USDT into AI-managed or yield-optimizing vaults and receive these tokens in return, which track the vault's net asset value (NAV).

categories.name: Liquid Staked BTC
categories.content: Liquid staked BTC is a tokenized representation of staked Bitcoin that can be traded or used in various DeFi applications.

categories.name: TRY Stablecoin
categories.content: A TRY stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Turkish lira.

categories.name: Yield Tokenization Product
categories.content: Yield tokenization product refers to converting the expected future yield or returns from an asset into tradable tokens on a blockchain, allowing for the trading, management, and optimization of yield independently from the underlying asset.

categories.name: Layer 2 (L2)
categories.content: Layer 2s are off-chain vertical scaling solutions that run on top of Layer 1 blockchains like Ethereum to improve scalability, while maintaining the decentralization and security standards of the Layer 1.

categories.name: Tokenized Money Market Fund (MMFs)
categories.content: Tokens that represent shares or units (1:1) of a regulated money market fund, issued or recorded on-chain by a regulated entity. The token is yield-bearing, passing through the fund's NAV and returns via accumulating or distributing share classes.

categories.name: SideChain
categories.content: A sidechain is a separate blockchain that runs parallel to a main blockchain. It allows transactions and applications to operate independently to enhance scalability and functionality.

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: Prediction Market Tools
categories.content: Cryptocurrencies representing projects that function as an application or tooling layer on top of decentralized prediction markets (like Polymarket, Kalshi etc.) to offer enhanced utilities. These platforms do not offer their own prediction bets and markets and instead leverages the liquidity, data, and settlement mechanisms of underlying prediction markets to provide enhanced user experiences, such as trading terminals, copy-trading bots, parlay engines, or social betting interfaces.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Neverland Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens issued by Neverland, a non-custodial decentralized lending and borrowing protocol built on the Monad blockchain including Neverland's native utility and governance tokens, alongside specific receipt tokens representing supplied liquidity or debt positions within its markets.

categories.name: Orynth Ecosystem
categories.content: Projects launched via Orynth, designed to let users trade on the attention and interest surrounding early-stage software products and MVPs.

categories.name: Tokenized Treasuries
categories.content: Tokenized Treasuries feature blockchain-native representations of marketable sovereign debt including T-bills, T-notes, and T-bonds that offer 24/7 on-chain access to yields through regulated, asset-backed tokens.

categories.name: Mascot-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to Mascot.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Tokenized Assets
categories.content: Tokenized products refers to digital representation of assets on a blockchain platform.
